description: Mega cruise ship (~5,000 passengers, ~2,000 crew), Oasis-class scale. Cabin-corridor resolution: 81 passenger corridor sections (~67 pax each) and 12 crew corridor sections (~170 crew each) replace legacy well-mixed berthing blocks. See docs/PLATFORM_CABIN_REVISION.md; legacy topology archived as messy_cruise_500.

zones.description: Navigation bridge and operations center. ~140 m² × 3.0m.
Forward adults-only solarium/glazed lounge. ~1,200 m² × 3.5m effective volume.
Main pool deck with several pools and sun-lounger zones. ~3,000 m² semi-open × 3m effective.
Sports court and outdoor recreation deck. ~600 m² semi-open × 3m.
Splash/waterpark complex. ~1,200 m² semi-open × 3m effective aerosol volume.
Pool bars and grill / casual service. ~400 m² × 3.5m.
Large spa, salon, thermal suite, and fitness center. ~1,200 m² × 3.5m.
Children's club and activity rooms. ~600 m² × 3.0m.
Teen lounge and games space. ~400 m² × 3.0m.
Open-air Central Park / atrium canyon spanning multiple decks. Effective mixing volume ~6,000 m² × 6m.
Indoor shopping promenade / central street, multi-deck void. ~7,000 m² × 6m.
Retail and duty-free shopping areas along promenade. ~1,800 m² × 3.5m.
Large casino floor. ~1,500 m² × 3.5m.
Library/card room/quiet lounge. ~120 m² × 3.5m.
Main dining room lower tier. ~3,000 m² × 3.5m.
Main dining room upper tier/balcony. ~2,400 m² × 3.5m.
Large buffet/lido restaurant. ~3,000 m² × 3.5m.
Central Park specialty restaurants group. ~800 m² × 3.5m.
Promenade/Boardwalk specialty restaurants group. ~700 m² × 3.5m.
Cafes, bakery, and quick-service venues. ~360 m² × 3.5m.
Primary crew mess for multiple sittings. ~600 m² × 3.5m.
Forward crew mess / staff cafeteria. ~300 m² × 3.5m.
Main theater spanning multiple decks. ~5,000 m² × 6m effective height.
Open-aft aqua theater and seating. ~3,000 m² × 6m effective volume.
Ice rink / studio theater. ~2,100 m² × 6m.
Comedy club, nightclub, and lounges. ~600 m² × 3.5m.
Ship medical center with treatment rooms, pharmacy, and sick bay. ~400 m² × 3.0m.
Dedicated isolation ward/negative-pressure cabins. ~150 m² × 3.0m.
Main galley supporting main dining rooms. ~1,600 m² × 3.5m.
Upper galley serving Windjammer and pool deck. ~1,000 m² × 3.5m.
Distributed specialty restaurant galleys. ~700 m² × 3.5m.
Central dry/cold/freezer stores and provisioning area. ~3,000 m² × 2.8m.
Main industrial laundry. ~1,500 m² × 2.8m.
Advanced wastewater treatment plant and garbage processing. ~2,000 m² × 2.8m.
Main machinery space spanning lower decks. ~5,000 m² footprint × 8.4m.
Engine control room and engineering office. ~200 m² × 3.0m.
